references.text: Previous campsite in the journey - Israel left Rissah and camped at Kehelathah, which is the place they are now leaving.
Next campsite in the journey - Israel continues from Har-shefer to Haradah.
Describes how the children of Israel departed from the Wilderness of Sinai in stages, providing the background for the entire journey in chapter 33.
A parallel description of Israel's journey through the wilderness, mentioning some of the same campsites.
